questions.question: What should the health endpoint represent? (I couldn’t inspect the local service because command access was declined.)

options.label: Liveness only (Recommended)
options.description: Returns service/process availability; dependency failures do not make it unhealthy.

options.label: Readiness
options.description: Also verifies required dependencies before returning success.

options.label: Both endpoints
options.description: Plans separate liveness and readiness routes.

questions.question: Which public route/response contract should we standardize on?

options.label: GET /health JSON (Recommended)
options.description: Use a stable JSON body such as {"status":"ok"} and HTTP 200.

options.label: GET /healthz text
options.description: Use a minimal plain-text probe endpoint.

options.label: Existing convention
options.description: Match another service; please name its repository/service in the free-text follow-up.

plan.content:
# Orders Service Health Check

Add `GET /health` returning `200 OK` with `{"status":"ok"}` (liveness only).
